update_weights_engine_params: update weights for the inference engine with a batch of named tensors across a device mesh
preprocess_tensor_dtensor: preprocess a torch tensor by converting DTensor to full tensor if needed
gather_serialized_tensors: gather serialized tensor batches from all TP ranks to rank 0 for weight update
